  "draft_contract_sha256_acknowledged": "999498499649f873f1f0eff32593d9d2a2c788f843f0484af77cf8868ce89e26",
  "verdict": "PASS_TO_SEPARATELY_AUTHORIZED_REPAIR2",
  "selection_bias_assessment": "PASS. The 14 inherited pairs are selected solely by pre-outcome completeness/provenance and attempt0-success prefix identity; the compatibility manifest records scientific_scores_read=false and the validator deliberately never reads ref['score'] (test I). The treatment-dependent failed pair e1-fmv-01/rep2 is quarantined, not analyzed, and Repair2 fresh-runs both arms. The eligibility rule (complete paired unit, both arms nominal attempt0 success, 18/18 heldout integrity, no parse error) is a pre-outcome integrity criterion, not a score- or outcome-conditioned filter. The inherited set spans streams e1-agj-00, e1-agj-01, e1-fmv-00, and e1-fmv-01 (replicates 0-1), determined by where the deterministic failure happened to stop, not by any measured effect. This avoids unacceptable post-treatment selection bias.",
  "prefix_compatibility_assessment": "PASS. For every inherited state, all 10 provider calls completed at attempt0 with zero parse errors; under max_parse_attempts=2 the correction branch is only entered after an attempt0 parse/apply failure, so the execution path for an attempt0-success state is byte-identical between max_parse_attempts=1 and =2. The manifest verifies all receipts are attempt=0, parse_error empty, provider_status completed, and patch_apply_correction_required=false. Inheritance of these 14 pairs under the Repair2 policy is scientifically valid because the extra branch was never exercised and could not have altered prompts, responses, skills, or evaluations.",
  "arm_symmetry_assessment": "PASS. max_parse_attempts=2, the 11-call updater unit limit, and the 191-call state limit are bound identically in the contract for both arms; the runner constructs the adapter and ProviderBudgetLedger from the same contract values for win_c and mrw with no arm-, stream-, or failure-conditioned allowance. The correction policy applies to whichever arm experiences an attempt0 deterministic parse/apply failure, and reliability counts are reported by arm without filtering.",
  "fresh_failed_pair_assessment": "PASS. The quarantine disposition is PRESERVE; EXCLUDE FROM VALID MANIFEST; REPAIR2 FRESH-RUNS BOTH ARMS; single_arm_resume_authorized=false and operator_semantic_patch_authorized=false. The runner treats any pre-existing partial update directory as a hard error (no auto-rerun), and e1-fmv-01/rep2 will be executed fresh for both win_c and mrw under the same current model identity (deepseek-v4-pro-ga-260813), pools, initial skill, policy, and SHA-salted time-balanced update/eval order as all other fresh pairs.",
  "valid_manifest_assessment": "PASS. Only the frozen 14-pair compatibility manifest (SHA 61e243...95bb) seeds inheritance; the runner copies exactly those rows into the content-addressed valid_replicates manifest and asserts the runtime inherited set equals the frozen manifest set. validate_valid_rows enforces exactly 48 rows, exactly four per stream across the 12 frozen streams, complete paired arms, exclusion of the quarantined unit/state, and directory discovery is forbidden. Analysis reads only this manifest.",
  "runtime_reliability_reporting_assessment": "PASS. correction_required/attempt0_success/correction_success/correction_failure are accumulated per arm into runtime_reliability as secondary outcomes; they are not used to include or exclude any pair from the primary estimand (validity is determined by completion and binding integrity, not by correction status). The Repair1 MRW patch-apply failure is separately reported as repair1_quarantined_patch_apply_failures {win_c:0, mrw:1} and carried into the analyzer output.",
  "provider_budget_assessment": "PASS. Nominal updater=10 with one explicit correction yields max=11 per unit; actor remains structurally <=180 (18 probes x 10 turns); state max=191; hard structural ceiling 96 x 191 = 18336. Claims are made before provider I/O, never released, provider_retry_limit=0 everywhere, and the adapter/runner tests prove the second failure stops with no third attempt (exactly 11 calls). The fresh-run pair's 10 quarantined calls are not reused, so Repair2's own ceiling is internally consistent.",
  "scientific_cardinality_assessment": "PASS. The design preserves exactly 12 stream D_s, four valid pairs per stream (48 pairs, 96 learned states), same treatment/control definitions, exact same pools, initial skill, renderer, updater entrypoint, verifier, 18 heldout probes, K=1, 8192 max output tokens, identical statistics (sign-flip over 2^12, TOST epsilon=1/18, bootstrap seed 1718, reps 100000), and the same time-balance salts. GPT/Kimi/Qwen scientific execution, second backbone, and public benchmark remain forbidden; authority bits are all false in the draft.",
  "remaining_blockers": [],
  "nonblocking_notes": [
    "The inherited 14 pairs cover only 4 of 12 streams; this is acceptable because selection is pre-outcome and the failed pair's stream (e1-fmv-01) retains two inherited replicates (rep0, rep1) while rep2 is fresh-run as a complete pair, so no stream is defined by a partial or treatment-failed unit.",
    "The fresh-run e1-fmv-01/rep2 pair will execute under the requalified 2026-08-31 model identity while inherited pairs ran under the 2026-08-30 identity; both bind the same requested and resolved model (deepseek-v4-pro-ga-260813), and the Repair2 contract freezes the fresh identity artifact for all new execution, so this is a documented requalification rather than a scientific variable change.",
    "Preflight enforces a fresh empty run_root and nonexistent valid manifest, preventing accidental reuse of any prior Repair2 artifacts.",
    "The analyzer correctly prioritizes TOST practical-null over a nominally significant superiority result, matching the predeclared decision priority."
  ],
  "execution_recommendation": "ALLOW_SEPARATE_REPAIR2_AUTHORIZATION",
  "second_backbone_recommendation": "HOLD",
  "paper_claim_authority": false,
  "single_sentence_verdict": "All eight gates pass: the Repair2 draft's pre-outcome, prefix-identical inheritance of 14 complete Repair1 pairs, paired fresh rerun of the quarantined failure, symmetric single-correction policy, fail-closed budgets, and exact 48-pair/12-stream manifest discipline are scientifically sound, so it may proceed only to a separately SHA-bound Repair2 contract and authorization after zero-provider preflight."
}

review.arm_symmetry_assessment: PASS. max_parse_attempts=2, the 11-call updater unit limit, and the 191-call state limit are bound identically in the contract for both arms; the runner constructs the adapter and ProviderBudgetLedger from the same contract values for win_c and mrw with no arm-, stream-, or failure-conditioned allowance. The correction policy applies to whichever arm experiences an attempt0 deterministic parse/apply failure, and reliability counts are reported by arm without filtering.
review.fresh_failed_pair_assessment: PASS. The quarantine disposition is PRESERVE; EXCLUDE FROM VALID MANIFEST; REPAIR2 FRESH-RUNS BOTH ARMS; single_arm_resume_authorized=false and operator_semantic_patch_authorized=false. The runner treats any pre-existing partial update directory as a hard error (no auto-rerun), and e1-fmv-01/rep2 will be executed fresh for both win_c and mrw under the same current model identity (deepseek-v4-pro-ga-260813), pools, initial skill, policy, and SHA-salted time-balanced update/eval order as all other fresh pairs.
nonblocking_notes: The inherited 14 pairs cover only 4 of 12 streams; this is acceptable because selection is pre-outcome and the failed pair's stream (e1-fmv-01) retains two inherited replicates (rep0, rep1) while rep2 is fresh-run as a complete pair, so no stream is defined by a partial or treatment-failed unit.

The fresh-run e1-fmv-01/rep2 pair will execute under the requalified 2026-08-31 model identity while inherited pairs ran under the 2026-08-30 identity; both bind the same requested and resolved model (deepseek-v4-pro-ga-260813), and the Repair2 contract freezes the fresh identity artifact for all new execution, so this is a documented requalification rather than a scientific variable change.
Preflight enforces a fresh empty run_root and nonexistent valid manifest, preventing accidental reuse of any prior Repair2 artifacts.
The analyzer correctly prioritizes TOST practical-null over a nominally significant superiority result, matching the predeclared decision priority.
review.prefix_compatibility_assessment: PASS. For every inherited state, all 10 provider calls completed at attempt0 with zero parse errors; under max_parse_attempts=2 the correction branch is only entered after an attempt0 parse/apply failure, so the execution path for an attempt0-success state is byte-identical between max_parse_attempts=1 and =2. The manifest verifies all receipts are attempt=0, parse_error empty, provider_status completed, and patch_apply_correction_required=false. Inheritance of these 14 pairs under the Repair2 policy is scientifically valid because the extra branch was never exercised and could not have altered prompts, responses, skills, or evaluations.
review.provider_budget_assessment: PASS. Nominal updater=10 with one explicit correction yields max=11 per unit; actor remains structurally <=180 (18 probes x 10 turns); state max=191; hard structural ceiling 96 x 191 = 18336. Claims are made before provider I/O, never released, provider_retry_limit=0 everywhere, and the adapter/runner tests prove the second failure stops with no third attempt (exactly 11 calls). The fresh-run pair's 10 quarantined calls are not reused, so Repair2's own ceiling is internally consistent.
review.runtime_reliability_reporting_assessment: PASS. correction_required/attempt0_success/correction_success/correction_failure are accumulated per arm into runtime_reliability as secondary outcomes; they are not used to include or exclude any pair from the primary estimand (validity is determined by completion and binding integrity, not by correction status). The Repair1 MRW patch-apply failure is separately reported as repair1_quarantined_patch_apply_failures {win_c:0, mrw:1} and carried into the analyzer output.
review.scientific_cardinality_assessment: PASS. The design preserves exactly 12 stream D_s, four valid pairs per stream (48 pairs, 96 learned states), same treatment/control definitions, exact same pools, initial skill, renderer, updater entrypoint, verifier, 18 heldout probes, K=1, 8192 max output tokens, identical statistics (sign-flip over 2^12, TOST epsilon=1/18, bootstrap seed 1718, reps 100000), and the same time-balance salts. GPT/Kimi/Qwen scientific execution, second backbone, and public benchmark remain forbidden; authority bits are all false in the draft.
review.selection_bias_assessment: PASS. The 14 inherited pairs are selected solely by pre-outcome completeness/provenance and attempt0-success prefix identity; the compatibility manifest records scientific_scores_read=false and the validator deliberately never reads ref['score'] (test I). The treatment-dependent failed pair e1-fmv-01/rep2 is quarantined, not analyzed, and Repair2 fresh-runs both arms. The eligibility rule (complete paired unit, both arms nominal attempt0 success, 18/18 heldout integrity, no parse error) is a pre-outcome integrity criterion, not a score- or outcome-conditioned filter. The inherited set spans streams e1-agj-00, e1-agj-01, e1-fmv-00, and e1-fmv-01 (replicates 0-1), determined by where the deterministic failure happened to stop, not by any measured effect. This avoids unacceptable post-treatment selection bias.
review.single_sentence_verdict: All eight gates pass: the Repair2 draft's pre-outcome, prefix-identical inheritance of 14 complete Repair1 pairs, paired fresh rerun of the quarantined failure, symmetric single-correction policy, fail-closed budgets, and exact 48-pair/12-stream manifest discipline are scientifically sound, so it may proceed only to a separately SHA-bound Repair2 contract and authorization after zero-provider preflight.
review.valid_manifest_assessment: PASS. Only the frozen 14-pair compatibility manifest (SHA 61e243...95bb) seeds inheritance; the runner copies exactly those rows into the content-addressed valid_replicates manifest and asserts the runtime inherited set equals the frozen manifest set. validate_valid_rows enforces exactly 48 rows, exactly four per stream across the 12 frozen streams, complete paired arms, exclusion of the quarantined unit/state, and directory discovery is forbidden. Analysis reads only this manifest.
